name: regexnoprefix
algorithm: The log filter of idiomatic/regex with the literal prefix taken out: [a-z]+=5[0-9]{2} [a-z]+=[0-9]{4,}ms, a find on every line of a 50 MB log, rounds times (README.md).

skip.c: no std regex in C (POSIX regex.h is not ISO C, and the MSVC CRT has none)
skip.rust: no std regex in Rust (the regex crate is not std; no crate stands in)
skip.mk-wrap: the only arithmetic is the checksum, far below 2^62

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries, each with its own engine; the checksum (a million per match plus its length) checks that both engines found the same matches
notes: Mk str.Lines and Regex.Find (forward and reverse DFA); Go strings.Lines and FindStringIndex. Without a literal prefix neither engine can skip ahead, so the row compares the automata.
